comment: Bundled institution surfaces marked ambiguous for a reason the bundle alone does not show, as "<entity id> <key>": "<reasons>". Flag 1 (the entry's location may settle the key): outside-subset, a ROR record outside the subset shares the key; campus-base, the key is an IPEDS base name before a campus that this institution does not share. Flag 2 (nothing settles it): acronym, an uncurated short form; shared-name, institution-shared-names.json or "U of" and one letter; contained, an uncurated alias of at most three words inside another institution's name; bracket, an uncurated alias whose key leaves its bracket out. Keys shared inside the bundle, and keys on an unresolved "st?", are not listed: the bundle shows them. Generated by npm run vocab:build; src/core/vocab/vocab.test.ts checks every flag against it.
